verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for spend and expense software, but the evidence describes only BILL's hosted service, APIs, webhooks, embeddable Elements and a hosted test sandbox. Nothing shows a self-hosted or on-premises deployment of the core product. The sandbox is a vendor-hosted test environment, not self-hosting, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
